<title level="2" right="Creature 17">[Blood-Pear Tree](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2570)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Unique" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=161" />
<trait label="NE" url="/Rules.aspx?ID=95" />
<trait label="Huge" />
<trait label="Undead" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=160" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #191: The Destiny War](/Sources.aspx?ID=199) pg. 55

**Perception** +29; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=12)

**Languages**
[Arboreal](/Languages.aspx?ID=26), [Necril](/Languages.aspx?ID=20), [Sylvan](/Languages.aspx?ID=10); (can't speak any language)

**Skills**
[Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +32, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) +30

<row gap="medium">
**Str** +9

**Dex** +5

**Con** +6

**Int** -2

**Wis** +6

**Cha** +2
</row>

**Plant** When it isn't in danger, the corpseroot spends 1 minute rooting to the earth, becoming planted in place. While the corpseroot is planted and immobile, creatures must actively [Seek](/Actions.aspx?ID=84) and succeed at a DC 36 Perception check (DC 40 in forests) to detect the corpseroot's true nature.

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">
**AC** 38 

**Fort** +31 

**Ref** +26 

**Will** +27 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**HP** 350
([negative healing](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=42))

</row>

**Immunities**
[death](/Traits.aspx?ID=40) effects, [disease](/Traits.aspx?ID=46), [paralyzed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=28), [poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=126), [unconscious](/Conditions.aspx?ID=38)

**Resistances**
bludgeoning 15, piercing 15

**Weaknesses**
axe vulnerability, [fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=72) 15

**Axe Vulnerability** The Blood-Pear Tree takes 15 additional damage from [axes](/WeaponGroups.aspx?ID=1).

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** 20 feet

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
branch +34 ([reach 15 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192)),
**Damage** 3d12+17 bludgeoning

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
root +34 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [reach 20 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192), [Trip](/Traits.aspx?ID=196)),
**Damage** 3d8+17 bludgeoning plus [Grab](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=18)

**Ranged**
<actions string="Single Action" />
bloody pear +30 ([range increment 20 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=248), [Splash](/Traits.aspx?ID=150)),
**Damage** 2d6+12 bludgeoning plus 2d6 bleed splash damage

**Take Root** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([Necromancy](/Traits.aspx?ID=117), [Primal](/Traits.aspx?ID=134)) **Frequency** once per round; **Requirements** The Blood-Pear Tree has a creature [grabbed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=20) or [restrained](/Conditions.aspx?ID=33); **Effect** The Blood-Pear Tree buries its roots into the creature, dealing 2d6+17 piercing damage (DC 38 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Fortitude save). On a failure, the creature is [enfeebled 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=13) (or increases the value by 1 if already enfeebled), and the corpseroot regains 15 HP. If this would make a creature enfeebled 5, the creature dies.

</column>
name: Blood-Pear Tree
